throttle.base.button.1.name: VIEW
throttle.base.button.1.note: VIEW button, upper side button of the stick head (manual item 10)

throttle.base.button.2.name: MENU
throttle.base.button.2.note: MENU button, lower side button of the stick head (manual item 11)

unplaced.throttle.axis.rotary.1: ladder (rudder rocker) under the back of the throttle handle (manual item 30), faces away from the camera
unplaced.throttle.button.1: LSB on the back of the throttle handle (manual item 29), faces away from the camera

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), throttle (left) and stick (right) seen from the front; stick head face (D-pad, Y/X/B, right stick) and its side buttons visible, the throttle handle's control face points right
mappingSource: HORI instruction manual p.2 "Layout" (https://horieurope.com/cdn/shop/files/EN_Instruction_Manual_Xbox_Flight_Stick.pdf, also a catalog source): joystick 1 right stick/RSB (Fire 1), 2 X, 3 Y, 4 D-pad, 5 B, 6 left stick (pitch/roll), 10 VIEW, 11 MENU, 12 A, 13 LSB+RSB (NEXT), 14 LB+RB (Fire 2); throttle 21 AUDIO, 22 D-pad, 23 LT+RT (PREV), 24 SHARE, 25 Xbox, 29 LSB, 30 ladder (LB/RB, Yaw), 31 throttle (LT/RT); catalog parts have no input numbers
note: Per the manual the green index trigger is the A button (item 12; green = Xbox A colour). The catalog's stick.trigger part is labelled "RSB / Fire 1", which per the manual is the press of the right mini-stick on top of the head (item 1); the marker follows the catalog label (on the mini-stick), see the report. VIEW and MENU are on the side of the joystick head (manual items 10/11), not on the throttle base as the catalog part ids (throttle.base.button.1/2) suggest; markers follow the manual. LSB (item 29) and the ladder/rudder rocker (item 30) are on the back of the throttle handle and face away from the camera.
